content_sections.heading: RITES Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: This is PESB Advt. No. 121/2026 for the Chairman & Managing Director post of RITES Limited. The CMD is the Chief Executive of the corporation. The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

rows.details: Public Enterprises Selection Board (PESB), for RITES Limited
Engineering Graduate or Chartered Accountant or Cost Accountant or Post Graduate or Graduate with MBA/ PGDIM from a recognized institute
At least 5 years of experience in the listed functional areas; regular employment in a listed type of organisation
Minimum 45 years; maximum is set by residual service before superannuation at 60 years
Last date for applicants: 3:00 PM on 11-12-2026
Shortlisting for interview by the Board

content_sections.heading: About RITES
content_sections.text: RITES Limited is a Navratna and Schedule 'A' Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Railways, incorporated on 26 April 2974. Its registered office is at New Delhi and its corporate office is at Gurugram. The notice says the company employed 1717 regular employees (1405 executives and 312 non-executives) as on 31.03.2026, and that the Government of India holds 72.20% of the shares.

content_sections.heading: RITES Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notice also says the total timeline for receipt of complete applications in PESB is 30 days from the date of uploading the job description on the PESB website.

content_sections.heading: RITES Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post, Chairman & Managing Director, and does not print the number of vacancies.

content_sections.heading: RITES Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: At least 5 years of cumulative experience/exposure during the last 10 years in Finance or Business Development or Production or Operations or Marketing or Project Management in a large organization of repute. OR at least 5 years of cumulative experience in core HR/IR/Personnel Management, along with at least 3 years of cumulative experience during the last 10 years in Finance or Business Development or Production or Operations or Marketing or Project management in a large organization of repute. Experience in Heavy & Medium Engineering / Railway sector is desirable. The applicant must be employed in a regular capacity, not in a contractual or ad-hoc capacity, on the date of application and on the date of interview, in one of the following: A Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE), including a full-time functional Director in the Board of a CPSE. Central Government Group 'A' Officers, including the Armed Forces of the Union and All India Services, and officers from Public Sector Banks, Financial Institutions and Autonomous Bodies. A State Public Sector Enterprise (SPSE) with annual turnover of Rs. 5,000 crore or more. A Private Sector Company, Joint Venture (50:50 JVs of Central/State Governments and JVs of CPSEs with other CPSEs/organisations) or National/State level Cooperative Federation with annual turnover of Rs. 5,000 crore or more. The turnover is the average audited annual turnover of the three financial years preceding the calendar year in which the post is advertised. For private companies, preference is given to candidates from listed companies. Applicants from private companies, JVs and Federations are arranged in order of annual turnover of their entities. Applicants from CPSEs must be in one of these scales, with minimum service in the eligible scale of one year for internal candidates and two years for others, as on the date of vacancy. Group 'A' officers of the Central Government, including All India Services and Autonomous Bodies, must hold a post of the level of Additional Secretary in Govt. of India or an equivalent post with equivalent scale of pay, on a substantive basis, on the date of application. An officer drawing the eligible pay scale merely on account of Non-Functional upgradation (NFU) or Next Below Rule (NBR) without holding a substantive post is not eligible to apply. Applicants from Public Sector Banks / Financial Institutions must be at Board level for one year on the date of application. Applicants from the Armed Forces of the Union must hold the level of Lt. General in the Army or equivalent rank in Navy/Air Force on the date of application. Applicants from State Public Sector Enterprises, Private Companies, JVs and Federations must be working at Board level on the date of application. Central Government Officers, including the Armed Forces of the Union, All India Services and officers from Public Sector Banks, Financial Institutions and Autonomous Bodies, are eligible for consideration only on immediate absorpt

content_sections.heading: RITES Job Description 2026
content_sections.text: The Chairman and Managing Director is the Chief Executive of the corporation and is accountable to its Board of Directors and Government. He/She is responsible for the efficient functioning of the Corporation for achieving its corporate objectives and performance parameters.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for RITES Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill up the application form online only, against this job description, on the PESB website https://pesb.gov.in/ . Applicants from private companies apply directly to PESB. All other applicants apply through the channel for their category (listed below). The nodal officer / competent authority then forwards the application online to PESB, as per para V(1) of the notice. The link for registration of nodal officers / competent authorities is on the PESB website. Attach the vigilance profile in the 13-point proforma prescribed by CVC (circular number 10/09/24 dated 06.09.2024) with the application form. Give the undertaking, as part of the application, that you will join the post if selected. An application without it is rejected. Submit the application by 3:00 PM on 11 December 2026. Forwarding by the nodal officer or competent authority is due by 5:00 PM on 21 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Applicants from Private Companies, JVs and Federations must submit these documents along with the application form: Annual Reports of the three financial years preceding the calendar year in which the post is advertised, of the organisation in which currently working (provide the URL or attach copies). Documentary proof that the company is listed, for applicants of a private company (URL or copies). Evidence of working at Board level. Self-attested copies of documents in support of age and qualifications. Details of relevant jobs handled in the past. Vigilance profile: the cadre controlling authority / competent authority should forward only applications of applicants who are clear from the vigilance angle, as per DPE guidelines, the latest being OM No. 15(2)/2001-DPE (GM)-FTS-4199 dated 28.10.2025. For SPSEs, JVs and Federations, the vigilance profile in the 13-point CVC proforma may be attached.

content_sections.text: The appointment is for five years from the date of joining, or up to the date of superannuation or until further orders, whichever is earlier. No application is entertained under any circumstances after the stipulated date. Incomplete applications and applications not received online within the stipulated date are rejected. Applications forwarded to PESB in physical form or through e-mail are rejected. Central Government candidates (including Armed Forces, All India Services and officers from Public Sector Banks, Financial Institutions and Autonomous Bodies): if unwillingness to join is conveyed after the interview, or after the offer of appointment, the candidate is debarred for two years from the date of interview or offer respectively, for a Board level post in any CPSE. CPSE candidates: the same two-year debarment applies for a Board level post in any CPSE other than the one to which the candidate belongs. SPSE, Private Company, JV and Federation candidates: the same two-year debarment applies for a Board level post in any CPSE. No request for relaxation or otherwise is entertained in these cases. All communications are to be addressed to the Secretary, Public Enterprises Selection Board, Public Enterprises Bhawan, Block No. 14, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RITES CMD post?
faq.answer: The last date for the applicant's online submission is 3:00 PM on 11 December 2026. Nodal officers and competent authorities must forward applications to PESB by 5:00 PM on 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for the RITES Chairman & Managing Director post?
faq.answer: The applicant should be an Engineering Graduate or Chartered Accountant or Cost Accountant or Post Graduate or Graduate with MBA/ PGDIM from a recognized institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the RITES CMD post?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 45 years. The maximum is 2 years of residual service for internal candidates and 3 years for others, as on the date of vacancy with respect to superannuation at 60 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the RITES CMD post?
faq.answer: The post carries Schedule A pay of Rs. 200000 – 370000 (IDA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the RITES CMD post?
faq.answer: Fill up the application form online on the PESB website, https://pesb.gov.in/. The nodal officer or competent authority then forwards it online, except for private company applicants, who apply directly to PESB. Physical or e-mail applications are rejected.

faq.question: Q6. How are candidates selected for the RITES CMD post?
faq.answer: The Board reserves the right to shortlist applicants for interview, keeping in view the extant guidelines issued from time to time.

faq.question: Q7. Who can apply for the RITES CMD post?
faq.answer: Applicants must be in regular employment, not contractual or ad-hoc, in a CPSE, Central Government Group 'A' service, a State PSE or a private company, JV or Federation with turnover of Rs. 5,000 crore or more. They must be so employed on the date of application and the date of interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can private company executives apply for the RITES CMD post?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants from private companies apply directly to PESB. They must hold a Board level position and enclose the annual reports, proof of listing, evidence of Board level work, age and qualification documents and details of relevant jobs handled.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the CMD appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is for five years from the date of joining, or up to the date of superannuation or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. What happens if a selected candidate refuses to join?
faq.answer: A candidate who conveys unwillingness to join after the interview or after the offer of appointment is debarred for two years from the date of interview or offer respectively, for a Board level post in a CPSE. For CPSE candidates this excludes their own CPSE.
